احتشدوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَشَدُوا (iḥtašadū) /iħ.ta.ʃa.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَشَدَ (iḥtašada)
# اِحْتَشِدُوا (iḥtašidū) /iħ.ta.ʃi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَشَدَ (iḥtašada)
